_doc: Night classification for every Evening-slot / night-language place in the trip. Drives replanning: only 'night' and 'show' are locked after dark; 'dusk' prefers sunset but works earlier; 'any' can move to daytime to free the evening. Default for unlisted places is 'any'. Slot=Evening in Notion means 'currently planned for the evening', NOT 'requires darkness' — that conflation is what pushed days past 21:30.

_levels.night: needs darkness — illumination, night cruise, night market, bar street, night viewpoint
_levels.show: fixed showtime (evening) — treat as a hard anchor
_levels.any: no darkness requirement — free to move into daytime

_closes_early_warning: Daci Temple and Wuhou Shrine are in the Evening slot but are ticketed sites that close ~17:00-18:00 — they cannot be done at night at all. Flagged for the Chengdu days.
